title: Rule builder-test-edit lets a builder write a probe under /tmp
why: Rule builder-test-edit refused a builder probe under /tmp, which decision builders-cannot-edit-tests (line 58) allows. A false alarm, reported by lane test-file-in-ci.
note: Coordinator 18:52 CST Nov 7. Nov 7 22:45 CST: held after round 3 (hole: after an uncertain cd with ;, newline or ||, a non-test file in a test folder is allowed). Archive archive/bpfa-build at 5fe1c2e70. Waiting-page item 396 builder-probe-round-4 asks for a fourth round. Owner item 396 a (06:08 CST Nov 8): the held fix gets a fourth round. A test-author pins the `;`, newline and `||` forms, the builder applies the either-folder fix, then one fresh review. Sighting (lane notes-fix-large-1, 06:57 CST Nov 8): a builder's read-only `python3 -c` probe that only printed `_quoted_words` was refused. Possible hole in the other direction: a builder's plain `touch tests/x` passes the builder check.
